scope.context: Existing Codex App conversation with prior implementation context; not blind discovery
scope.mechanism: Native tools.mcp__deveco__ calls in the current Codex App conversation, with returned content preserved locally; no Codex CLI model substitution.
scope.image_judgement: Two review images were rendered to the current model before submitting outcomes; control assertions remain separate.

totals.note: Calls include diagnosis and explicit fixture restoration. A successful protocol response is not a passed feature; hot_reload.reset is a semantic failure.

focused_regressions.test_step_action_and_assertion: Each round executed click + visible assertion, then two-stage image review, finish and report export.

fixture_restoration.note: Full deployment explicitly restores the test fixture; it does not turn the failed reset test into a pass.

findings.cause: MCP implementation treats removal of inactive patches as rollback of an active patch.
findings.evidence: reset returned true; after stop/launch the click still displayed Codex Patch, two assertions failed, and native bm query still reported patch 3000001.
findings.test_gap: Existing SDK test checks reset.reset but does not relaunch and assert restored behavior.

findings.evidence: Existing pending recording failed retrieval with open source media file failed; session retained, no discard or replacement recording.
Diagnostic bm quickfix -h was refused by the read-only command policy. Subsequent native bm inspection is separate shell diagnosis, not counted as MCP success.
